description.value:
As part of the action used to cast this power, you must make a melee weapon attack against a creature within your reach, or the power fails. On a hit, the attack deals its normal damage, and you may teleport to an unoccupied space of your choice within 10 feet of you; if you appear within 5 feet of the target, it cannot take reactions until the end of its next turn.

At 5th level, the melee attack deals an extra 1d6 energy damage, increasing to 2d6 at 11th level and 3d6 at 17th level.
